recipes.title: Brewed Spearmint, Date & Orange Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Fragrant warm rolled oats simmered in freshly steeped dried spearmint herbal tea and milk, topped with sweet diced dates and orange zest.

ingredient_details.note: 1.5 tsp dried spearmint steeped 5 minutes and strained

steps: Steep dried spearmint leaves in 3/4 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, then strain.
Simmer rolled oats, brewed spearmint tea, milk, and chopped dates 6 to 7 minutes until creamy and tender.
Spoon into a warm bowl and finish with orange zest and chopped walnuts.
tips: Spearmint is gentler and sweeter than peppermint, pairing wonderfully with warm grains and fruit.
Naturally caffeine-free and soothing for digestion.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Berry, Honey & Dried Spearmint Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool plain Greek yogurt topped with sweet strawberries, blueberries, toasted oats, honey, and a delicate crumble of dried or fresh spearmint.

ingredient_details.item: crumbled dried spearmint (or 1 tbsp fresh snipped)

steps: Spoon plain Greek yogurt into a chilled bowl and layer with sliced strawberries and blueberries.
Rub dried spearmint gently between your fingers to wake its sweet aroma and sprinkle over the fruit.
Top with toasted rolled oats and a light drizzle of honey.
tips: Rubbing dried spearmint between your fingertips releases fresh essential oils right before eating.
High in morning protein and takes under 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Gentle Turkish Cilbir-Style Yogurt, Poached Eggs & Spearmint
recipes.summary: Traditional Turkish breakfast layering room-temperature garlicky Greek yogurt, soft poached eggs, warm olive oil, sweet paprika, and dried spearmint.
steps: Stir room-temperature Greek yogurt with grated garlic and a pinch of salt and swoosh across a shallow bowl.
Warm olive oil gently off-heat with sweet paprika and crumbled dried spearmint for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Nestle warm poached eggs over the creamy yogurt and drizzle the ruby-green spearmint oil across the top.
tips: Warming dried spearmint in gentle olive oil is a classic Turkish technique that turns it vibrant and deeply aromatic.
Ultra-soft, protein-rich, and delicious scooped with warm whole-grain bread.

recipes.title: Smashed Sweet Pea, Spearmint & Feta Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Bright spring whole-grain toast spread with tender mashed sweet green peas, lemon juice, olive oil, feta, and sweet spearmint.
steps: Warm frozen peas briefly with 2 tbsp water until bright green and tender, then drain.
Mash warm peas roughly with olive oil, lemon juice, spearmint, and a pinch of salt.
Spread onto warm whole-grain toast and top with crumbled feta cheese.
tips: Sweet peas and spearmint are an iconic spring combination—packed with plant fiber and protein.
Add a soft-boiled egg on top for extra breakfast staying power.

recipes.title: Chilled Spearmint Tea, Cantaloupe & Vanilla Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Cooling make-ahead oats soaked overnight in brewed spearmint tea, oat milk, chia seeds, and vanilla, served with sweet cantaloupe cubes.

ingredient_details.note: 1.5 tsp dried spearmint steeped 5 minutes, strained and cooled

steps: Steep dried spearmint in 3/4 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain, and let cool.
Stir cooled spearmint tea, oat milk, rolled oats, chia seeds, and vanilla in two jars and refrigerate overnight.
Top with sweet chilled cantaloupe cubes right before serving.
tips: Sweet melon and mild spearmint taste crisp and refreshing on warm mornings.
Zero cooking and ready straight from the fridge.

recipes.title: Turkish Ezogelin-Style Red Lentil & Dried Spearmint Soup
recipes.summary: Beloved Anatolian pantry soup simmering red lentils, tomato, onion, and olive oil, finished with classic fragrant dried spearmint and lemon.
steps: Soften diced onion in olive oil 4 minutes, then stir in crushed tomatoes and dried spearmint 1 minute until deeply aromatic.
Add rinsed red lentils and vegetable broth; simmer 15 minutes until red lentils melt creamy and soft.
Blend lightly for velvety texture, brighten with fresh lemon juice, and ladle warm.
tips: Dried spearmint is the authentic heart of Turkish lentil soups—giving gentle warmth and a clean herbal finish.
Naturally dairy-free, high-fiber, and soothing to swallow.

recipes.title: Cool Mediterranean Cacik Cucumber, Chickpea & Spearmint Bowl
recipes.summary: Cooling Turkish yogurt-and-cucumber midday bowl enriched with protein-rich chickpeas, olive oil, lemon, garlic, and fragrant dried spearmint.
steps: Whisk Greek yogurt with 3 tbsp cold water, grated garlic, lemon juice, half the dried spearmint, and a pinch of salt.
Fold in finely diced cucumber and rinsed chickpeas.
Divide into two chilled bowls and finish with extra-virgin olive oil and the remaining dried spearmint.
tips: Wonderfully hydrating, gut-friendly, and cool on warm afternoons.
Scoop with soft pita wedges or eat cleanly with a spoon.

recipes.title: Bright Quinoa, Parsley, Tomato & Spearmint Tabbouleh
recipes.summary: Levantine-inspired gluten-free tabbouleh combining fluffy quinoa, diced cucumber, ripe tomatoes, fresh parsley, lemon, olive oil, and spearmint.
steps: Whisk lemon juice, extra-virgin olive oil, dried spearmint, and a pinch of salt in a salad bowl; rest 3 minutes so the spearmint softens.
Fold in cooked quinoa, chopped parsley, diced tomatoes, and cucumber.
Toss gently and serve cool or room temperature.
tips: Quinoa swaps in effortlessly for bulgur wheat while adding complete plant protein.
Tastes even brighter after chilling 30 minutes in the fridge.

recipes.title: 12-Minute Velvet Sweet Pea & Spearmint Soup
recipes.summary: Vibrant emerald green soup simmering frozen sweet peas, mild onion, vegetable broth, and aromatic spearmint into a silky dairy-free puree.
steps: Soften diced onion in olive oil 3 minutes, then add vegetable broth, frozen sweet peas, and spearmint.
Simmer gently just 5 minutes so the peas keep their vivid emerald green color.
Blend completely velvety smooth with an immersion blender and finish with fresh lemon juice.
tips: Frozen sweet peas are naturally rich in plant protein and fiber and require zero chopping.
Swirl a spoonful of Greek yogurt on top if you enjoy a creamy finish.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Chickpea, Feta & Spearmint Salad
recipes.summary: Hydrating sweet-savory midday bowl combining juicy watermelon cubes, tender chickpeas, cucumber, feta, lime, olive oil, and spearmint.
steps: Whisk lime juice, extra-virgin olive oil, and spearmint in the bottom of a wide bowl.
Add watermelon cubes, rinsed chickpeas, and diced cucumber and toss lightly.
Scatter crumbled feta across top and enjoy cold.
tips: Adding chickpeas turns a refreshing summer melon salad into a balanced, filling lunch.
Deeply hydrating on hot days.

recipes.title: Moroccan-Style Poached Chicken, Apricot & Spearmint Tagine
recipes.summary: Fragrant North African skillet stew gently simmering chicken thighs with soft dried apricots, chickpeas, cinnamon, lemon, and spearmint over couscous.
steps: Nestle chicken thighs, halved apricots, chickpeas, cinnamon, half the spearmint, and chicken broth in a wide skillet.
Cover and simmer gently 18 minutes until chicken hits 165 F and apricots turn jammy-soft.
Stir in fresh lemon juice and remaining spearmint and spoon over warm fluffy couscous.
tips: Mild sweet spice and spearmint give rich Moroccan character with zero chili heat.
Chicken thighs and simmered apricots stay tender and effortless to cut.

recipes.title: Tender Greek Spearmint & Lemon Turkey Meatballs with Orzo
recipes.summary: Juicy baked lean turkey meatballs scented with Greek dried spearmint, garlic, and lemon zest, served over soft spinach orzo with yogurt sauce.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; mix ground turkey, quick oats, egg, minced garlic, lemon zest, dried spearmint, and a pinch of salt gently into 12 soft meatballs.
Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake 15 to 16 minutes until 165 F and lightly golden.
Serve warm over cooked orzo alongside a spoonful of cool plain Greek yogurt.
tips: Using quick oats instead of breadcrumbs keeps lean turkey meatballs pillow-soft and adds whole-grain fiber.
Freeze extras for 3-minute future dinners.

recipes.title: Baked Lemon Salmon with Spearmint Pea & Potato Mash
recipes.summary: Flaky baked salmon fillets plated over bright green sweet-pea and Yukon Gold potato mash perfumed with sweet spearmint and olive oil.
steps: Boil cubed potatoes 12 minutes, adding frozen peas for the final 2 minutes; meanwhile bake salmon with 1 tsp olive oil and lemon juice at 400 F for 12 minutes.
Drain potatoes and peas, reserving 3 tbsp hot water, and mash smooth with remaining olive oil and spearmint.
Serve flaky baked salmon right over the bright green spearmint mash.
tips: Soft mash and flaky fish require minimal chewing while packing omega-3s and fiber.
Naturally dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Baked Spearmint, Chickpea & Tomato Zucchini Boats
recipes.summary: Tender halved zucchini roasted soft and filled with savory rice, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, and fragrant dried spearmint.
steps: Heat oven to 375 F; scoop seeds gently from halved zucchini with a spoon and place cut-side up in a baking dish.
Mix cooked rice, lightly mashed chickpeas, diced tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and dried spearmint and mound into the zucchini.
Add 3 tbsp water to the dish, cover loosely with foil, and bake 20 to 22 minutes until zucchini is fork-tender.
tips: Inspired by Greek and Lebanese stuffed squash—covering with foil ensures super-soft tender zucchini.
Top with a spoonful of cool plain Greek yogurt before serving.

recipes.title: Warm Turkish Eggplant, Lentil & Dried Spearmint Stew
recipes.summary: Meltingly soft diced eggplant and green lentils braised in tomato, garlic, olive oil, and abundant fragrant dried spearmint.
equipment: Dutch oven or wide skillet with lid
steps: Saute peeled diced eggplant and onion in olive oil 6 minutes until beginning to soften.
Stir in garlic and dried spearmint 45 seconds, then add diced tomatoes, cooked lentils, and 1/2 cup water.
Cover and simmer gently 12 to 14 minutes until eggplant is velvety soft; serve warm over rice or yogurt.
tips: Dried spearmint blooms warmly inside braised Mediterranean tomato stews.
Plant-based, rich in fiber, and wonderfully tender.

recipes.title: Creamy Dark Cocoa, Avocado & Spearmint Tea Smoothie
recipes.summary: Wholesome mint-chocolate shake blending chilled brewed spearmint tea, oat milk, creamy avocado, frozen banana, and cocoa powder.

ingredient_details.note: 1.5 tsp dried spearmint steeped 5 minutes and strained

steps: Steep dried spearmint in 1/2 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain, and chill with 3 ice cubes.
Combine chilled spearmint tea, oat milk, frozen banana, avocado, and cocoa powder in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until velvety smooth and mint-chocolatey.
tips: Sweet spearmint tastes like a cool bakery mint-chocolate cup without artificial extracts.
Naturally dairy-free and sweetened solely by ripe banana.

recipes.title: Chilled Strawberry, Greek Yogurt & Spearmint Smoothie
recipes.summary: Refreshing pink smoothie uniting chilled brewed spearmint tea, Greek yogurt, frozen strawberries, banana, and a drop of honey.

ingredient_details.note: 1.5 tsp dried spearmint steeped 5 minutes and strained

steps: Brew dried spearmint in 3/4 cup hot water 5 minutes, strain, and chill.
Combine chilled spearmint tea, Greek yogurt, frozen strawberries, banana, and honey in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until thick, frosty pink, and completely silky.
tips: Using chilled brewed spearmint tea guarantees zero dried leaf specks while infusing clean sweet mint flavor.
High-protein and cooling on warm afternoons.

recipes.title: Cool Pineapple, Cucumber & Spearmint Spa Smoothie
recipes.summary: Crisp green refresher blending chilled brewed spearmint tea, frozen pineapple, cucumber, baby spinach, and lime juice.
steps: Blend chilled brewed spearmint tea, baby spinach, and chopped cucumber 20 seconds until smooth.
Add frozen pineapple and lime juice and blend 35 seconds more until frosty emerald green.
Serve immediately.
tips: Tastes like a cool tropical mojito smoothie with zero alcohol and gentle hydration.
Dairy-free, nut-free, and naturally bright.

recipes.title: Blueberry, Sweet Peach & Brewed Spearmint Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant antioxidant blend combining chilled brewed spearmint tea, oat milk, frozen blueberries, frozen peaches, and vanilla.
steps: Pour chilled brewed spearmint tea and oat milk into a blender.
Add frozen blueberries, frozen peaches, and vanilla extract.
Blend 45 seconds until deep berry-violet and smooth.
tips: Keep a chilled pitcher of dried spearmint tea in the fridge to make this 2-minute smoothie effortless.
Naturally sweet without any added sugar.

recipes.title: Frosty Watermelon, Kefir & Spearmint Summer Smoothie
recipes.summary: Light, gut-friendly pink smoothie uniting frozen watermelon cubes, plain kefir, lime juice, and chilled brewed spearmint tea.
steps: Add chilled spearmint tea, plain kefir, frozen watermelon cubes, and lime juice to a blender.
Blend 40 seconds until airy, slushy-smooth, and bright coral.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Freeze leftover diced watermelon on a tray for instant cooling smoothies.
Gentle probiotics and soothing spearmint in one refreshing glass.

recipes.title: Iced Moroccan Brewed Spearmint & Citrus Press
recipes.summary: Caffeine-free Moroccan-inspired patio cooler pouring freshly steeped dried spearmint tea over ice with orange juice, lemon juice, and honey.
steps: Steep dried spearmint in 1 1/2 cups hot water covered 5 minutes, strain cleanly, and dissolve honey while warm.
Cool briefly and stir in freshly squeezed orange juice and lemon juice.
Pour generously over tall glasses of ice and enjoy crisp.
tips: Orange and lemon juices turn simple spearmint tea into a vibrant, refreshing afternoon punch.
Naturally caffeine-free so you can sip it any hour.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Lime & Brewed Spearmint Cooler
recipes.summary: Crystal-smooth strained watermelon juice brightened with chilled brewed spearmint tea and fresh lime juice over ice.
steps: Blend seedless watermelon cubes, chilled strong spearmint tea, and lime juice 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into two ice-filled glasses.
Serve icy cold right away.
tips: Zero added sweetener—ripe melon and cooling spearmint are pure summer refreshment.
Great way to stay hydrated on warm days.

recipes.title: Sparkling Pineapple, Ginger & Spearmint Tea Tonic
recipes.summary: Crisp bubbly refresher uniting pure pineapple juice, chilled brewed spearmint tea, fresh ginger juice, and plain sparkling water.
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice cubes.
Pour in chilled brewed spearmint tea, pure pineapple juice, and fresh ginger juice.
Top with plain sparkling water, give one gentle stir, and enjoy crisp.
tips: Refreshing mocktail feel with soothing ginger and sweet spearmint.
Swap sparkling water for still chilled water if preferred.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Green Apple & Spearmint Garden Press
recipes.summary: Clean green juice pairing chilled brewed spearmint tea with fresh cucumber juice, unsweetened apple juice, and bright lemon.
steps: Combine chilled brewed spearmint tea, fresh cucumber juice, apple juice, and lemon juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently until thoroughly chilled.
Sip immediately.
tips: Light, clean, and refreshing without excess natural sugar.
Great midday hydration boost.

recipes.title: Ruby Tart Cherry & Chilled Spearmint Evening Press
recipes.summary: Soothing caffeine-free evening cooler blending unsweetened tart cherry juice, chilled brewed spearmint tea, and a light squeeze of lime.
steps: Pour chilled brewed spearmint tea, tart cherry juice, and lime juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently (adding 1/2 tsp dissolved honey if your cherry juice is very tart).
Enjoy chilled and calming.
tips: Spearmint cools and softens brisk tart cherry juice effortlessly.
100% caffeine-free and rich in ruby antioxidants.
